name: Evidence doc stack
oneLiner: printed pages on real scanned paper are dealt one per beat onto a pile beside the speaker, each landing a little askew while the ones under it fall into shadow and a glass counter ticks the page count, then a yellow highlighter swipes the key line on the top page
say: when the speaker shows the paper trail ('it produced a 7-page report with timestamps', 'I read every filing'): one page lands per section they name, the highlighter lands on the finding they quote; set highlight to that line
